title: euryloma × aristella

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Aristella are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, which may help to soothe respiratory issues, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation.
